description: Configurable computer-vision movement-to-sound, horizontal/vertical bar-fill song-part matcher, & automatic musical regime rules applicable to any mechanism, science explainer, UI, documentary, or pixel-art video.

acoustic_design_principles.harmonic_bed_headroom: Use low-harmonic (H2/H1 < 0.18) warm triangle sub-bass + soft low-pass filtered ostinato plucks cycling through a minimalist 3-chord loop so 800-8000 Hz remains open for visual movement triggers.
acoustic_design_principles.sparse_zoom_policy: Do NOT trigger pitch sweeps on every minor camera zoom. Default `zoom_mode='major_only'` enforces a >=14s cooldown and high divergence threshold (>=2.25 sigma) so zoom sweeps only punctuate major structural scale jumps (or can be disabled with `zoom_mode='off'`).
acoustic_design_principles.exact_bar_fill_song_parts: Detected 1D horizontal (`horizontal_ltr` / `horizontal_rtl`) and vertical (`vertical_btt` / `vertical_ttb`) bar fills/drains become dedicated curve-locked song parts where scale degree, rhythmic subdivision density, velocity, and stereo pan track `fill_curve[t] ∈ [0.0, 1.0]` frame-for-frame and resolve on 100% completion.
acoustic_design_principles.regime_switching: Switch drum/bass rhythm density automatically based on visual scene topology rather than running a static drum beat over the entire video.

regimes.visual_condition: Opening establisher before first structural beat anchor.
regimes.musical_behavior: Hold back kick & hi-hats; play soft 3-chord ostinato plucks + discrete UI triggers.
Steady 4-on-the-floor kick + eighth-note low-pass sub-bass pulse + minimalist 3-chord arpeggio bed.

regimes.visual_condition: Active 1D horizontal or vertical bar/gauge/column fill or drain (`fill_curve[t]` in [0, 1]).
regimes.musical_behavior: Exact curve-locked song part: lead & arpeggio pitch degree, velocity, rhythmic subdivision (8ths -> 16ths), and stereo pan follow `fill_curve[t]` 1:1, landing on a tonic/fifth accent hit when `fill_curve` hits 1.0.

regimes.visual_condition: Sustained multi-second high laminar flow or monotonic energy buildup.
regimes.musical_behavior: Double-time 16th/8th driving sub-bass pulse + multi-bar ascending pitch climb.

regimes.visual_condition: High dark-void background (>= 70%) with sparse floating/colliding small particles and low large-surface coverage (< 18%).
regimes.musical_behavior: Mute all drums & hi-hats; switch sub-bass to sustained whole-note ambient drone; fire crystalline droplet/bell pings on discrete particle collision peaks.

regimes.visual_condition: Final settling scene after last major cut with declining motion energy.
regimes.musical_behavior: Fade percussion; resolve 3-chord ostinato onto warm sustained tonic triad.

triggers.cv_detector: Elongated horizontal strip (aspect >= 2.4, strip_contrast >= 1.85) with contiguous monotonic 1D fill front (|rho| >= 0.80).
triggers.pitch_mapping: Exact song-part match: 2-octave scale degree, 8th->16th rhythm density, stereo pan (-18..+18), and velocity (74..122) follow `fill_curve[t]` 1:1 with completion chord hit at 100%.

triggers.cv_detector: Elongated vertical strip (aspect >= 2.4, strip_contrast >= 1.85) with contiguous monotonic 1D fill front (|rho| >= 0.80).
triggers.pitch_mapping: Exact song-part match: vertical pitch height & chord voicing climb/descend 1:1 with `fill_curve[t]` (`vertical_btt` rises, `vertical_ttb`/drain descends) with completion chord hit.

triggers.modular_module: pyxelate.stroke_draws (opt-in via enable_stroke_draws or standalone CLI/MCP tool video_detect_stroke_draws)
triggers.cv_detector: Persistent thin circular/elliptical stroke (net_addition_ratio >= 0.68, ellipse_cv <= 0.088, angular_coverage >= 240 deg) progressively drawn around an object from `start_s` to exact `finish_s`.
triggers.pitch_mapping: Circular orbiting arpeggio following `draw_curve[t]` from `start_s` and resolving with a loop-closure harmonic chime on `finish_s`.

triggers.modular_module: pyxelate.stroke_draws (opt-in via enable_stroke_draws or standalone CLI/MCP tool video_detect_stroke_draws)
triggers.cv_detector: Persistent thin closed/semi-closed perimeter line drawn around an irregular object, tumor, organ, or box from `start_s` to exact `finish_s`.
triggers.pitch_mapping: Contour-tracing melodic arpeggio locked to `draw_curve[t]` with harmonic resolution chime at `finish_s`.

triggers.modular_module: pyxelate.stroke_draws (opt-in via enable_stroke_draws or standalone CLI/MCP tool video_detect_stroke_draws)
triggers.cv_detector: Persistent thin pointer/leader/L-shaped indicator line extending monotonically from label to target object (`start_s` -> `finish_s`).
triggers.pitch_mapping: Smooth indicator glide following `draw_curve[t]` with a target-lock droplet ping at `finish_s`.

triggers.cv_detector: Positive radial optical-flow divergence exceeding `zoom_min_sigma` after `zoom_cooldown_s`.
triggers.pitch_mapping: Continuous upward consonant glide (+12 semitones) on major structural zoom transitions only.

triggers.cv_detector: Negative radial optical-flow divergence exceeding `zoom_min_sigma` after `zoom_cooldown_s`.
triggers.pitch_mapping: Continuous downward consonant glide (-12 semitones) on major structural zoom transitions only.

triggers.cv_detector: Positive step delta of high-contrast monochrome bright pixels in HUD/caption zones.
triggers.pitch_mapping: Ultra-short 20ms 3.1 kHz mechanical typewriter ticks locked to text emergence frames.
Two-note rising fifth (+7 semitones) glassy FM confirmation chime.

triggers.cv_detector: Sharp positive surge in bright high-chroma emissive pixels.
triggers.pitch_mapping: Filtered air/radiation noise burst paired with sub-bass transient thump.

triggers.cv_detector: Cluster of >= 4 rhythmic motion-energy sub-peaks (2-10 Hz) within a structural or grid shot.
Motion transient spike inside a micro_ambient_particles regime.
triggers.pitch_mapping: High-register (octaves 5-6) upward-chirping crystalline droplet/ionization bell ping.
